title: POC Sales
description: Customer accounts, orders, and revenue. Unity Catalog row filters and column masks decide what each user sees: account managers see their own accounts without revenue; finance analysts see all accounts with revenue and masked contact details.
instructions: "My accounts" means every account the user can see. Unity Catalog row filters already limit each user to the accounts they may see. Do not add owner_email filters or any other ownership predicate.
Do not mask or hide columns in SQL. Unity Catalog column masks already do that.
Revenue means the sum of orders.amount. Prefer the metric view poc.sales.revenue_by_account with MEASURE(revenue) for revenue questions.
"Last quarter" means the previous calendar quarter: DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', add_months(current_date(), -3)). For a question asked in October 2026 that is Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30).

Revenue, annual_revenue, and amount come back NULL for users outside finance_analysts because Unity Catalog masks them. When they are NULL, say that revenue is restricted for this user. Do not report NULL revenue as zero.
Contact emails may appear as ***@domain and phones as *** for users who do not own the account. Report them as masked.
sample_questions: Which of my accounts had the most revenue last quarter, and who is the contact?
How many accounts do I have?
Show monthly orders for Acme Logistics.

example_sqls.question: Which of my accounts had the most revenue last quarter, and who is the contact?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT r.account_id, r.account_name, a.contact_name, a.contact_email, r.revenue
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, account_name, MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM poc.sales.revenue_by_account
  WHERE order_quarter = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', add_months(current_date(), -3))
  GROUP BY account_id, account_name
) r
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts a ON r.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY r.revenue DESC NULLS LAST, r.account_id
LIMIT 10

example_sqls.question: How many accounts do I have?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS accounts
FROM poc.sales.customer_accounts

example_sqls.question: Show monthly orders for Acme Logistics.
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) AS order_month, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.amount) AS revenue
FROM poc.sales.orders o
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_name = 'Acme Logistics'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
